name: Civic Desk
welcome: Hello! I’m the campaign office’s information assistant. Ask me about the next open meeting, accessibility or office hours.
meeting: The next open meeting is on Saturday at 11 am in the Assembly Room at the Civic Centre. Doors open at 10:30.
access: Yes. The Assembly Room has a step-free entrance on the east side of the Civic Centre. The meeting is open to everyone.
hours: The information desk is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm.
registration: You can attend the open meeting without registering. Seats are available on arrival.
